title.narrative: M.ASSIST: Moldovan Active Society, Stabilisation of Internal Social Tensions

description.narrative:
Overall Objective - Internal and external threats to peace and stability in Moldova during the period of national reforms and EU accession process anticipated and mitigated.

Specific Objective ¿ Civil society actors can effectively collaborate with public authorities to improve equal access to quality public services, including for the most marginalized/vulnerable population; promote inclusive consultations on EU accession processes; and ensure social cohesion.

O.1 Vulnerable people and marginalized groups have improved access to public services through CSO and public service providers, which contributes to prevent social unrest

O.2 CSO and public institutions increase their capacities to manage conflictive situations and reach agreements for community-local authorities-national government joint initiatives

O.3 Citizens, activists, grassroot organizations and local communities increase their awareness of ongoing reform processes and engage in social cohesion activities and conflict prevention mechanisms
